en.titre:
HABITS THAT MAKE
YOU MORE
ATTRACTIVE.

en.texte: Look at people when they talk to you. It makes them feel heard and you look sure of yourself.
A clean room says a lot before you say anything. Make the bed, clear the floor.
Run slow enough to talk, that's how you last. Personally, a running coach app like Atala tells me when to slow down.
One jacket that fits your shoulders upgrades every outfit you own.
A man who can cook a real dinner is always a good surprise.
